title: Early tetrapod neck mobility modelled using an extant analogue
title_zh: 基于现存类比的早期四足动物颈部灵活性建模
abstract: Abstract Tetrapods arose from lobe-finned fishes with a notochord-dominated axial column 1–3 . During this transition, the skull became separated from the shoulder girdle 4–6 , giving rise to a neck region. This head–shoulder separation has generated hypotheses suggesting that neck mobility increased during the origin of tetrapods, facilitating the ecological transition towards more terrestrial habitats 4,5,7–9 . However, incompletely co-ossified vertebral components 10 have posed a challenge to modelling the mobility of these early tetrapod necks. Here we used material tests on the similarly configured axial columns of sturgeon to predict the capacities of the tetrapod neck region for lateral flexion, extension and rotation across the tetrapod stem. Our model indicates that the soft tissue-dominated axial column was surprisingly rigid, despite lacking co-ossified vertebral components. We estimate that most stem tetrapods could move their heads less than 6° laterally and less than 3° dorsally but could not rotate them. Notably, mobility did not shift in conjunction with the head–shoulder separation that occurred between the origin of tristichopterids (represented by Eusthenopteron ) and that of more crownward stem tetrapods. Therefore, mobility in the tetrapod neck did not serve as a functional driver of head–shoulder separation. Instead, forelimb-driven locomotion, implicated in early tetrapods 11–14 , provides a better functional explanation for the head–shoulder separation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 四足动物从具有鞭索动物主干的硬骨鱼进化而来 1–3 。在这一过渡过程中，头骨与肩胛带分离 4–6 ，形成了颈部区域。头肩分离产生了假说，认为四足动物起源时颈部灵活性增加，有助于向更陆生栖息地的生态过渡 4,5,7–9 。然而，椎骨未完全骨化的成分 10 给这些早期四足动物颈部的灵活性建模带来了挑战。在此，我们利用鲟鱼同样配置的主干进行材料测试，以预测四足动物谱系中颈部区域在侧向屈曲、伸展和旋转方面的能力。我们的模型表明，以软组织为主的主干出人意料地僵硬，尽管缺乏椎骨共同骨化成分。我们估计，大多数谱系四足动物的头部侧向移动不足6°，向上移动不足3°，但无法旋转。值得注意的是，在三齿鲈类（以尤斯테诺波特龙为代表）起源与更接近冠群谱系四足动物之间发生的头肩分离过程中，灵活性并未随之转变。因此，四足动物颈部的灵活性并非头肩分离的功能驱动因素。相反，早期四足动物中提到的前肢驱动的运动 11–14 为头肩分离提供了更好的功能解释。
